doc.title: Bill Holman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999

title: Jazz education and few opportunities
summary: Jazz education produces many players but few professionals.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Becoming a teacher: jazz in schools and conservatories

blocks.x: Jazz has been kind of elevated in one sense to a pretty, art form, but I’m not sure that — the opportunities for it are not rising with that.
No they’re not. Nobody knows what happens to all those guys that take jazz education. Some of them become teachers, a few of them become professionals, but there’s a whole lot that don’t.
